protocol.population: Nonclinical adults with sufficient general running history, across frequent trail, city/occasional trail, and road/gym resource contexts; strength novices are a distinct module population.
interventions: Low-volume strength introduction or bounded familiar training
Outdoor trail exposure where observed history supports it
comparators: Level versus graded and treadmill versus overground running
outcomes: Limits of dose and transfer claims
protocol.review_design: Rigorous targeted source appraisal and evidence-to-decision mapping; not a de novo exhaustive systematic review or meta-analysis.
protocol.screening: Single-agent targeted selection of authoritative review evidence and contrasting direct studies; no duplicate independent screening/extraction was performed.
selection_rules: Prefer a current authoritative synthesis for healthy-adult strength plus direct runner evidence.
Use direct treadmill/graded comparisons for modality limits, and contrasting downhill studies for soreness/fatigue interpretation.
Exclude clinical, pediatric, animal, supplementation and preprint findings from treatment-effect claims.
Do not use article snippets or inaccessible full text to invent effects.
scope_limits: Wide discovery queries were limited to the first 20 returned records; all remaining hits are explicitly unretrieved, not screened exclusions.
No independent SPORTDiscus, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science or publication-bias analysis was performed.
No new pooled effect or calibrated dose-response model was calculated.
